newsitem.title: UK: UK's Neepsend sees profit below estimates.
newsitem.headline: UK's Neepsend sees profit below estimates.

text.p: British engineering firm Neepsend Plc said on Tuesday it expected its pretax profit for the year to fall below market expectations and last year's results.
The company cited temporary problems at two units, Ferro Alloys & Metals Ltd and Cintride Ltd.
Neepsend also said it expected to recommend an unchanged final dividend of 1.8p net per share for the year to March 30, 1997.
The shares were marked down 10.5p to 31 by 1010 GMT.
Neepsend said Ferro Alloys had a severe downturn in trading due to temporary shift in customers' buying patterns to lower margin products.
It added that Cintride had been loss-making for some time, but noted that it expected the unit to return to profitability in the financial year ending in March 1998.
